messages:
Aisha (acct exec): Heads up 11 WillowCare sent a security questionnaire + POC checklist. They require IdP-initiated SAML, SCIM push with delta support, tenant-scoped RBAC, and strict domain ownership proofing. Can we confirm support surface and any Dedicated pricing deltas?
Marco (solutions): We support SP-initiated and IdP-initiated SAML. SCIM 2.0 supported; for deltas we recommend PATCH + ETag/ifMatch. RBAC can be implemented via group mapping or a dedicated `role` claim mapping. Need to know target provisioning latency and expected churn rate.
Oliver (eng): Confirmed: IdP-initiated flows are fine. On Dedicated we can enable an optimized SCIM ingestion pipeline; default throttle is conservative (200 req/min) but can be increased for a POC. For >10k users we recommend batching + incremental sync windows. Also note assertion expiry defaults to 1h, can be shortened.
Jenny (security): They asked about KMS/HSM for signing keys and 7-year audit retention. We have KMS integrations for Private; Dedicated can support customer-managed keys/HSM with contract addendum in certain regions. Long-term retention usually an add-on for logs.
Aisha (acct exec): WillowCare wants domain proof via DNS TXT + file and to lock tenants to verified domains so external domains can't sign up. Any blockers?
Marco (solutions): Domain verification available (DNS TXT or HTML upload). Tenant-level domain locking is a console toggle (admin only). For SCIM attribute mapping we can show a sample mapping; e.g.:
```
{"externalId":"{{idp.userId}}","userName":"{{email}}","active":true,"groups":["{{idp.groups}}"]}
```
Use as an illustrative example during the runbook.
Oliver (eng): Caveat: near-real-time sync for 100k+ users needs a rate uplift + possibly a dedicated ingestion worker pool. We'll propose a staging plan: bulk import day 0, then deltas thereafter. Also call out SCIM pagination behavior for large groups.
Jenny (security): Also need to confirm audit trails for admin role changes and SCIM events. We can stream event logs to their SIEM (syslog/CloudWatch/Datadog) depending on deployment. Extended retention is possible as an add-on.
Aisha (acct exec): Pricing question: is SCIM/RBAC included in base Dedicated price or is it an add-on? Quick answer for the buying committee?
Marco (solutions): Base Dedicated covers SSO and standard SCIM. High-volume SCIM ingestion, HSM/KMS, and extended audit retention are add-ons. Typical integration support (mapping, custom attributes) is ~1-2 engineer-days for a standard POC; we can include that in a one-time services line.
Oliver (eng): For the POC we can spin up a committed Dedicated sandbox in dedicated-nyc-01. Deploy-bot, can you provision? We'll mirror their IdP in staging and run an end-to-end provisioning test.
Deploy-bot: New POC environment provisioned: dedicated-nyc-01 (id: poc-174999).
Marco (solutions): Next steps: 1) share SCIM mapping guide + SAML SP metadata; 2) produce estimate for HSM and extended logs add-ons; 3) schedule 45m SSO+provisioning workshop with WillowCare including engineering/SRE. Who can join tomorrow 10am PT?
Aisha (acct exec): I'll book 10am PT. Marco, paste the SP metadata and a short add-on pricing one-pager here. Jenny, can you confirm compliance notes (audit retention + KMS) by EOD?
Jenny (security): On it. I'll attach SOC2/ISO excerpts we use for Dedicated buyers and draft the contract clause around KMS/HSM.
Oliver (eng): I'll prepare a short doc on rate limits, batch windows, and suggested sync strategy for >10k users.
Marco (solutions): Link I'll use in the meeting: https://console.redwood.ai/docs/scim and SAML SP metadata (will paste in calendar invite).
Aisha (acct exec): Thanks everyone 1 :thumbsup: If anyone expects >8 hours of engineering time for custom work, flag here so I can justify on the commercial side.
